row.title: Intent Yield tenant: the unit of input is an intent, the unit of output is a kept outcome
row.body: Proposed tenant instances/intent-yield: output counts only when the intent's outcome passes an independent probe, survives 30 days and is not restated. No count enters the measure and no person is scored. v1 dogfoods on the owner directives in agents/AGENTS.md.
